name: 9298-specdecode-7b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf (target) + JackFram/llama-68m (draft). meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf is gated; NousResearch's is the standard ungated mirror of the same weights. ~13.6 GB to fetch.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process vLLM engine; the draft worker lives inside it, so there is one LLMEngine and no router or external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=64, warmup the first 25% by completion, bounded at 2560 requests / 1800 s safety, data seed static 9298. FLOOR: do not read this setup below 32 streams -- it is declared as a loaded server.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. FIXED SHAPE: 550 prompt tokens and 150 output tokens with zero variance, greedy (temperature 0). The backend forces ignore_eos whenever max_tokens is set, so every request emits exactly 150 tokens.
purpose: A 7-billion-parameter chat assistant with a small draft model, answering 64 concurrent fixed-length prompts on one GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit ec10cb8511b7e30b8ff86caab2e4272ff3ceddca (v0.6.2-183-gec10cb8511b7).
# V0 draft-model speculative decoding: a 7B target confirming 3 proposed tokens per step from a
# 68M draft, with CUDA graph capture off.
# Chunked prefill and multi-step scheduling are REFUSED alongside speculative decoding at this
# commit -- the engine raises. Do not add them, and do not add keys from a later vLLM.

# Ungated mirror of the gated meta-llama repository; same weights.
model: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf

# Target and draft vocab sizes must be EQUAL (both 32000); the draft inherits the target's
# dtype and eager setting.
speculative-model: JackFram/llama-68m

num-speculative-tokens: 3

# FORCED: the engine refuses to start speculative decoding without the V2 block manager here.
use-v2-block-manager: true

enforce-eager: true

# LOAD-BEARING. 2048 is the DRAFT checkpoint's own position limit while the target declares 4096;
# pinning the target down to it keeps the pair on one declared context length. The workload needs
# 550 + 150 = 700 tokens, so nothing is truncated.
max-model-len: 2048

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# The checkpoints' own torch_dtype, written down so two runs cannot differ on it.
dtype: float16

# Engine defaults, written down so a later default flip cannot silently change the setup.
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
